categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Tianzhen Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high polymer composite flooring materials. Its main product lines include PVC composite flooring such as WPC (wood-plastic composite), SPC (stone-plastic composite), LVT (luxury vinyl tile), and the newly developed RPET composite flooring. The company serves as a leading manufacturer in the polymer flooring industry, focusing on environmentally friendly and innovative flooring solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced production technologies including WPC foam core secondary molding, SPC extrusion one-time molding, PVC flooring online pattern matching, LVT online lamination, and automated stone-plastic mixing systems. It has developed proprietary technologies and holds 31 patents, including 20 invention patents. The RPET flooring incorporates recycled PET materials and 3D printing technology to enhance durability, appearance, and environmental sustainability, marking a significant technological breakthrough in the industry.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tianzhen's primary customers are internationally renowned flooring brand companies, building material retailers, and trading companies, mainly located in North America, Europe, Latin America, and Southeast Asia. The company’s products are widely used in residential, commercial, healthcare, educational, and retail environments. The U.S. market is the largest consumer of PVC flooring and a key target market for the company’s products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases and sales networks in China, Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand), the United States, and Hong Kong. It has established a 'three-in-one' global production layout to mitigate trade risks and optimize supply chains. Its sales are predominantly export-oriented, with over 98% of revenue generated from overseas markets, especially the U.S., Canada, Germany, and other developed countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Tianzhen Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of polymer composite flooring products. It procures raw materials such as PVC resin, calcium carbonate, stabilizers, and recycled PET, and produces finished flooring products for brand owners and retailers, mainly under ODM arrangements.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on the development and industrialization of new environmentally friendly materials like RPET composite flooring. It invests in R&D to improve product performance, reduce costs, and expand product categories including outdoor flooring and wall panels. The company also advances automation and intelligent manufacturing processes, such as 3D printing technology, to enhance product quality and customization capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of polymer composite flooring products under ODM contracts to international brand owners and retailers. The company operates on a direct sales and trade intermediary model, fulfilling orders based on customer contracts. It also generates minor revenue from domestic sales and leasing of idle properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tianzhen is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the high polymer flooring industry, ranking among the top tier in China with advanced R&D and production capabilities. The industry is fragmented with many low-end producers; however, Tianzhen differentiates itself through proprietary technologies and a broad product portfolio. It is among the first to commercialize RPET flooring, maintaining a technological and market lead over competitors who are still in R&D stages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 891.5 million, representing a 186% increase year-over-year, driven by strong recovery in the second half of the year. Despite still reporting a net loss of RMB 37.2 million, the loss narrowed significantly compared to the previous year, with profitability achieved in Q4. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 3.28 billion, with a stable financial structure and ongoing investments in capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Tianzhen Technology offers environmentally friendly, high-performance polymer flooring products that combine durability, ease of installation, and aesthetic appeal. Its RPET composite flooring uniquely integrates recycled materials and advanced 3D printing technology, providing superior physical properties and visual effects compared to traditional PVC flooring. The company’s global production footprint and strong R&D capabilities enable it to deliver high-quality, cost-competitive products tailored to diverse international markets, enhancing customer value and competitive advantage.
